name: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Details
description: The package must identify the responsible manufacturer, packer or importer with full name and complete address.

name: Country of Origin
description: Imported products must clearly declare the country where they were manufactured, produced or assembled.

name: Common / Generic Name of Commodity
description: The package must state the common or generic identity of the commodity; brand name alone is insufficient.

name: Net Quantity Declaration
description: The package must declare net quantity excluding packaging in prescribed standard metric/SI units (g, kg, ml, L, m, cm, number).

name: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing
description: Declaration of month and year of manufacture or packing in permitted MM/YYYY or Month Year format.

name: Best Before / Use By Date
description: Commodities subject to quality deterioration or perishability must declare Best Before or Use By date.

name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
description: Maximum Retail Price inclusive of all taxes in Indian currency (₹ or Rs. with 'inclusive of all taxes').

name: Dimensions Declaration
description: Where nature of commodity requires dimensions (textiles, hardware), finished metric dimensions must be stated.

name: Consumer Care Details
description: Name, address, telephone number, and email address of the person/office to contact in case of consumer complaints.

name: Declarations on E-Commerce / Digital Listings
description: Mandatory package declarations must be displayed to the buyer on digital marketplaces prior to purchase.

name: Searchable & Sortable Country-of-Origin Filter
description: E-commerce entities selling imported products must provide a searchable and sortable country-of-origin filter.

name: Unit Sale Price (USP)
description: Unit sale price (e.g. ₹ per g / kg / ml / L / number) declared to facilitate easy consumer price comparison.

name: Principal Display Panel (PDP) & Minimum Character Size
description: Mandatory declarations on PDP must satisfy Table-I minimum character height (1.0mm to 6.0mm based on PDP area).
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 7 & Table-I

name: Net Quantity Numeral Size & Surrounding Clearance
description: Prescribed numeral size and clear space around net quantity (vertical gap ≥ 1 numeral height; horizontal ≥ 2× numeral height).

name: LPG Cylinder Weighing & Delivery Verification
description: Class III weighing instruments (max 50kg, e=10g) maintained at distribution point and available during customer delivery.

name: Declarations on Wholesale Packages
description: Wholesale packages must declare manufacturer/importer identity, commodity identity, and total retail unit count / net quantity.

name: Exemptions for Certain Packages
description: Statutory exemptions for packages ≤ 10g/10ml, industrial/institutional consumers, or specified drug formulations under strict provisos.
